scope: Exact first-byte SRJ emitted by core from the native ButterStick DDR subsystem. All 581 pads on seven incident components retained. Eight shared DQ nets, each with FPGA U4 and RAM U11/U12 endpoints. No pads, placements, routing rules, copper layers or physical terminals changed. Existing board copper removed; roundrect pads use conservative rotated rectangles. No timing constraints added.
